questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 37: joint operation means workers of the enterprise, contractors and subcontractors working during the same period at the same workplace.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第38條協議組織應協議之事項，包括對下列何種危險作業之管制？
questions.c_zh: 動火、高架、開挖、爆破、高壓電活線等
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 38, the coordination organization shall discuss the control of which dangerous operations?
questions.c_en: Hot work, work at height, excavation, blasting, live high-voltage work, etc.
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第38條第3款：從事動火、高架、開挖、爆破、高壓電活線等危險作業之管制。其他包括安全衛生管理配合、局限空間及危險物有害物作業環境管制、變更管理、統一信號標示、機械設備使用協調、高低氣溫作業風險預防等。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 38(3): control of dangerous operations such as hot work, work at height, excavation, blasting and live high-voltage work; other items include coordination of management, confined space and hazardous substance control, change management, unified signals and signage, equipment use coordination, and high/low temperature risk prevention.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者不是施行細則第41條所定安全衛生工作守則應包含之內容？
questions.a_zh: 事業之安全衛生管理及各級之權責
questions.q_en: Which of the following is NOT required content of the safety and health work rules under Enforcement Rules Article 41?
questions.a_en: Safety and health management and responsibilities at each level
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第41條列十款：安全衛生管理及各級權責、機械設備器具操作規範與維護檢查、工作安全衛生標準、教育訓練、健康指導及管理、急救及搶救、防護設備之準備維持使用、個人防護具維護使用、事故通報及報告、其他安全衛生事項。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 41 lists ten items including management responsibilities, equipment operation and maintenance, work safety standards, training, health guidance, first aid and rescue, protective equipment, PPE, accident reporting and other matters.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 事業單位設有工會者，本法第34條及第37條所定「勞工代表」由何者產生？
questions.q_en: In an enterprise with a labor union, how are the 'laborer representatives' under Articles 34 and 37 of the Act selected?
questions.b_en: Assigned by the labor inspection agency
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第43條：勞工代表，事業單位設有工會者，由工會推派之；無工會組織而有勞資會議者，由勞方代表推選之；無工會組織且無勞資會議者，由勞工共同推選之。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 43: with a union, nominated by the union; without a union but with a labor-management meeting, elected by the labor-side representatives; with neither, elected jointly by the laborers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 本法第37條第2項「八小時內通報」之起算時點為何？應向何者通報？
questions.a_zh: 自事業單位明知或可得而知已發生職業災害事實起；向事業單位所在轄區之勞動檢查機構通報
questions.b_zh: 自醫院開立診斷書起；向保險公司通報
questions.c_zh: 自災害發生後24小時起；向警察機關通報
questions.d_zh: 自媒體報導起；向勞動部通報
questions.q_en: When does the 8-hour reporting period under Article 37(2) begin, and to whom is the report made?
questions.a_en: From when the enterprise knew or could have known of the accident; to the labor inspection agency of the jurisdiction where the enterprise is located
questions.b_en: From issuance of the medical certificate; to the insurer
questions.c_en: 24 hours after the accident; to the police
questions.d_en: From media coverage; to the Ministry of Labor
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第47條第1項：應於八小時內通報，指事業單位明知或可得而知已發生規定之職業災害事實起八小時內，應向其事業單位所在轄區之勞動檢查機構通報。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 47(1): the 8 hours run from when the enterprise knew or could have known that a reportable accident occurred, and the report goes to the labor inspection agency of the jurisdiction where the enterprise is located.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 本法第37條第2項第2款「罹災人數在三人以上」，依施行細則第48條係指哪些失能類型之總人數？
questions.d_zh: 永久全失能、永久部分失能及暫時全失能
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 48, 'three or more victims' in Article 37(2)(2) counts the total of which disability types?
questions.d_en: Permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第48條第1項：罹災人數在三人以上者，指於勞動場所同一災害發生工作者永久全失能、永久部分失能及暫時全失能之總人數達三人以上者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 48(1): the total number of workers with permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability in the same accident reaching three or more.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第49條所稱「重傷之災害」，須住院治療連續達多少小時以上？
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 49, a 'serious injury accident' requires continuous hospitalization of at least how many hours?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第49條第2項：重傷之災害，指造成罹災者肢體或器官嚴重受損，危及生命或造成其身體機能嚴重喪失，且須住院治療連續達二十四小時以上之災害者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 49(2): serious injury means severe damage to limbs or organs that endangers life or causes serious loss of bodily function, requiring continuous hospitalization of 24 hours or more.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 依施行細則第51條，勞工人數在多少人以上之事業，應依本法第38條按月填報職業災害統計？
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 51, enterprises with how many laborers or more shall file monthly occupational accident statistics under Article 38?
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第51條第1項：本法第38條所定中央主管機關指定之事業：一、勞工人數在三十人以上之事業。二、勞工人數未滿三十人之事業，經中央主管機關指定者。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 51(1): enterprises with 30 or more laborers, and enterprises with fewer than 30 laborers if designated by the central competent authority.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 施行細則第46條之1所定發生職業災害時雇主應即採取之急救、搶救措施，包括下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 對發生職業災害之工作場所進行人員清點，及管制現場，禁止其他工作者進入
questions.b_zh: 立即清理現場恢復作業
questions.q_en: Under Enforcement Rules Article 46-1, the employer's immediate first aid and rescue measures after an occupational accident include:
questions.a_en: Conducting a headcount at the accident site and controlling the scene to prohibit entry of other workers
questions.b_en: Immediately clearing the scene to resume work
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第46條之1：使有立即危險之虞之工作者退避至安全場所；對災害工作場所進行人員清點及管制現場，禁止其他工作者進入；提供緊急應變人員必要之個人防護具與設備及規劃緊急撤離機制；其他必要緊急應變措施。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 46-1: withdraw workers at imminent risk to safety; conduct headcounts and control the scene to bar other workers; provide PPE and equipment to emergency responders and plan evacuation; other necessary emergency measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生法施行細則
questions.q_zh: 職業安全衛生法施行細則於民國115年6月26日修正發布之條文，自何日施行？
questions.q_en: The provisions of the Enforcement Rules amended and promulgated on 26 June 2026 (ROC 115) take effect on:
questions.explain_zh: 施行細則第54條：一百十五年六月二十六日修正發布之條文，自一百十五年七月一日施行。
questions.explain_en: Enforcement Rules Article 54: the provisions amended on 26 June ROC 115 (2026) take effect on 1 July ROC 115 (2026).

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 依職業安全衛生設施規則，「高壓」係指何種電壓範圍？
questions.b_zh: 超過六百伏特至二萬二千八百伏特
questions.c_zh: 超過二萬二千八百伏特
questions.d_zh: 超過一百五十伏特至六百伏特
questions.q_en: Under the OSH Facilities Rules, 'high voltage' refers to which range?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：特高壓指超過二萬二千八百伏特；高壓指超過六百伏特至二萬二千八百伏特；低壓指六百伏特以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: extra-high voltage exceeds 22,800 V; high voltage is over 600 V up to 22,800 V; low voltage is 600 V or below.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 職業安全衛生設施規則所稱「低壓」，係指多少伏特以下之電壓？
questions.q_en: Under the Rules, 'low voltage' means voltage not exceeding:
questions.explain_zh: 第3條：低壓係指六百伏特以下之電壓。
questions.explain_en: Article 3: low voltage means 600 volts or below.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 職業安全衛生設施規則所稱「車輛機械」，下列何者屬之？
questions.q_en: Which of the following is a 'vehicle-type machine' under the Rules?
questions.explain_zh: 第6條：車輛機械係指能以動力驅動且自行活動於非特定場所之車輛、車輛系營建機械、堆高機等。
questions.explain_en: Article 6: vehicle-type machines are power-driven vehicles that move freely in non-specific places, including vehicle-type construction machinery and forklifts.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 依設施規則第13條，下列何者屬閃火點未滿攝氏零下三十度之易燃液體？
questions.q_en: Under Article 13, which is a flammable liquid with a flash point below -30°C?
questions.explain_zh: 第13條第1款：乙醚、汽油、乙醛、環氧丙烷、二硫化碳及其他閃火點未滿攝氏零下三十度之物質。乙醇、甲醇為零度以上未滿三十度；煤油為三十度以上未滿六十五度。
questions.explain_en: Article 13(1): ether, gasoline, acetaldehyde, propylene oxide, carbon disulfide and other substances with flash point below -30°C. Ethanol and methanol are 0–30°C; kerosene is 30–65°C.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何者屬設施規則第12條所稱之「著火性物質」？
questions.q_en: Which is a 'pyrophoric/ignitable substance' under Article 12?
questions.explain_zh: 第12條著火性物質包括金屬鋰、鈉、鉀、黃磷、赤磷、賽璐珞類、碳化鈣、鎂粉、鋁粉等。氯酸鉀為氧化性物質、硝化甘油為爆炸性物質、乙炔為可燃性氣體。
questions.explain_en: Article 12 lists lithium, sodium, potassium, yellow/red phosphorus, celluloid, calcium carbide, magnesium and aluminum powder, etc. Potassium chlorate is oxidizing, nitroglycerin explosive, acetylene a flammable gas.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 設施規則所稱高壓氣體，常用溫度下壓縮氣體之表壓力應達每平方公分多少公斤以上？
questions.q_en: Under the Rules, a compressed gas is 'high-pressure gas' when its gauge pressure at normal temperature reaches at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第18條第1款：在常用溫度下，表壓力達每平方公分十公斤以上之壓縮氣體（不含壓縮乙炔氣）；壓縮乙炔氣及液化氣體則為每平方公分二公斤以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 18(1): compressed gas with gauge pressure of 10 kg/cm² or more at normal temperature (excluding compressed acetylene); compressed acetylene and liquefied gas thresholds are 2 kg/cm².

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 設施規則所稱「局限空間」之定義，不包括下列何項特徵？
questions.a_zh: 面積在十平方公尺以下
questions.b_zh: 無法以自然通風維持充分清淨空氣
questions.d_zh: 非供勞工在其內部從事經常性作業
questions.q_en: Which is NOT part of the definition of 'confined space' under the Rules?
questions.a_en: Floor area of 10 m² or less
questions.b_en: Natural ventilation cannot maintain sufficient clean air
questions.c_en: Restricted means of entry and exit
questions.d_en: Not intended for regular work inside
questions.explain_zh: 第19條之1：局限空間指非供勞工在其內部從事經常性作業，勞工進出方法受限制，且無法以自然通風來維持充分、清淨空氣之空間。與面積大小無關。
questions.explain_en: Article 19-1: a confined space is not intended for regular work, has restricted entry/exit, and cannot maintain sufficient clean air by natural ventilation. Size is not a criterion.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用道路作業之工作場所，日間封閉車道逾多少小時，或夜間封閉車道逾多少小時，應訂定安全防護計畫？
questions.a_zh: 日間逾二小時、夜間逾一小時
questions.b_zh: 日間逾八小時、夜間逾四小時
questions.c_zh: 日間逾四小時、夜間逾二小時
questions.d_zh: 日間逾一小時、夜間逾半小時
questions.q_en: For road work, a safety protection plan is required when a lane is closed for more than how long?
questions.explain_zh: 第21條之2第1項第7款：日間封閉車道、路肩逾二小時或夜間封閉車道、路肩逾一小時者，應訂定安全防護計畫，並指派專人指揮勞工作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 21-2(1)(7): closing a lane or shoulder for over 2 hours in daytime or over 1 hour at night requires a safety protection plan and a designated person to direct the work.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用道路作業之作業人員，應戴用及穿著何種裝備以利辨識？
questions.b_zh: 一般工作帽及深色工作服
questions.d_zh: 有反光帶之安全帽及顏色鮮明有反光帶之施工背心
questions.q_en: Workers doing road work shall wear what for visibility?
questions.b_en: An ordinary cap and dark work clothes
questions.d_en: A safety helmet with reflective strips and a brightly colored reflective vest
questions.explain_zh: 第21條之2第1項第2款：作業人員應戴有反光帶之安全帽，及穿著顏色鮮明有反光帶之施工背心，以利辨識。
questions.explain_en: Article 21-2(1)(2): workers shall wear safety helmets with reflective strips and brightly colored construction vests with reflective strips.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 依設施規則第21條之3，下列何種作業應於作業前實施風險評估並通報勞動檢查機構，且紀錄留存三年？
questions.a_zh: 高度五十公尺以上施工架組立及拆除作業
questions.c_zh: 高度三公尺之施工架組立
questions.q_en: Under Article 21-3, which operation requires a pre-work risk assessment, notification to the labor inspection agency, and 3-year record keeping?
questions.a_en: Erecting or dismantling scaffolds 50 m or higher
questions.explain_zh: 第21條之3所列作業包括：易踏穿屋頂作業、繩索作業、塔式起重機升高拆卸、吊籠作業、模板支撐高度七公尺以上且面積一百平方公尺以上灌漿、高度五十公尺以上施工架組拆、開挖深度十八公尺以上且面積五百平方公尺之開挖等。
questions.explain_en: Article 21-3 lists operations such as work on fragile roofs, rope access, tower crane climbing/dismantling, gondola work, concrete pouring with formwork supports ≥7 m and ≥100 m², scaffolds ≥50 m, and excavations ≥18 m deep and ≥500 m².

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 建築物之工作室，其樓地板至天花板淨高原則上應在多少公尺以上？
questions.q_en: The clear height from floor to ceiling of a workroom shall generally be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第25條：雇主對於建築物之工作室，其樓地板至天花板淨高應在二．一公尺以上。但建築法規另有規定者，從其規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 25: the clear height from floor to ceiling of a workroom shall be at least 2.1 m, unless building regulations provide otherwise.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 工作用階梯之設置，其斜度不得大於幾度？梯級面深度不得小於幾公分？
questions.a_zh: 斜度六十度、深度十五公分
questions.b_zh: 斜度四十五度、深度十公分
questions.c_zh: 斜度七十五度、深度二十公分
questions.d_zh: 斜度三十度、深度二十五公分
questions.q_en: For working stairs, the maximum slope and minimum tread depth are:
questions.explain_zh: 第29條：工作用階梯寬度不得小於五十六公分（原動機與鍋爐房或機械四周通往工作台者）、斜度不得大於六十度、梯級面深度不得小於十五公分、應有適當扶手。
questions.explain_en: Article 29: working stairs shall be at least 56 cm wide (in engine/boiler rooms or around machinery), slope not over 60°, tread depth not less than 15 cm, with suitable handrails.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主使勞工於局限空間作業前，應先確認有無危害，有危害之虞者應訂定何種計畫？
questions.q_en: Before confined-space work, if hazards are possible the employer shall formulate what plan?
questions.explain_zh: 第29條之1：有危害之虞者，應訂定危害防止計畫，並使現場作業主管、監視人員、作業勞工及相關承攬人依循辦理。內容包括危害確認、濃度測定、通風換氣、隔離措施、進入許可程序、緊急應變等。
questions.explain_en: Article 29-1: a hazard prevention plan covering hazard identification, gas measurement, ventilation, isolation, entry permit procedures, emergency response, etc., followed by supervisors, watchers, workers and contractors.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 局限空間作業場所入口應公告之注意事項，包括下列何者？
questions.q_en: Which must be posted at the entrance of a confined-space worksite?
questions.explain_zh: 第29條之2：入口公告事項包括應經許可始得進入之重要性、進入時應採取之措施、事故發生時之緊急措施及聯絡方式、現場監視人員姓名、其他注意事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 29-2: the notice includes the importance of entry by permit only, measures on entry, emergency measures and contacts, the on-site watcher's name, and other precautions.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 局限空間作業之氧氣及危害物質濃度確認，應由專人辦理，其紀錄應保存幾年？
questions.q_en: Records of oxygen and hazardous-substance concentration checks for confined-space work shall be kept for:
questions.explain_zh: 第29條之5第2項：前條及前項所定確認，應由專人辦理，其紀錄應保存三年。第29條之6之進入許可與進出紀錄亦保存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 29-5(2): the checks shall be done by a designated person and records kept for 3 years; entry permits and entry/exit logs under Article 29-6 are also kept for 3 years.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 局限空間作業之進入許可，應由何人簽署後始得使勞工進入？
questions.a_zh: 雇主、工作場所負責人或現場作業主管
questions.q_en: A confined-space entry permit must be signed by whom before workers enter?
questions.a_en: The employer, workplace manager or on-site supervisor
questions.explain_zh: 第29條之6第1項：進入許可應由雇主、工作場所負責人或現場作業主管簽署後，始得使勞工進入作業；對勞工之進出應確認、點名登記，並作成紀錄保存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 29-6(1): the entry permit shall be signed by the employer, workplace manager or on-site supervisor; entry and exit shall be confirmed, logged by name and kept for 3 years.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工進入局限空間從事焊接、切割等動火作業時，除進入許可外，還應辦理何事？
questions.b_zh: 指定專人確認無危害之虞，並簽署動火許可
questions.q_en: For hot work (welding, cutting) inside a confined space, in addition to the entry permit, what is required?
questions.b_en: A designated person confirms no hazard and a hot-work permit is signed
questions.c_en: An application to the fire department
questions.explain_zh: 第29條之6第3項：進入局限空間從事焊接、切割、燃燒及加熱等動火作業時，應指定專人確認無發生危害之虞，並由雇主、工作場所負責人或現場作業主管確認安全，簽署動火許可後，始得作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 29-6(3): hot work in a confined space requires a designated person to confirm no hazard and a hot-work permit signed by the employer, workplace manager or on-site supervisor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 局限空間作業區域超出監視人員目視範圍者，應使勞工佩戴何種裝備？
questions.b_zh: 全身背負式安全帶及可偵測人員活動情形之裝置
questions.q_en: When a confined-space work area is beyond the watcher's line of sight, workers shall wear:
questions.b_en: A full-body harness (CNS 14253-1) and a device that detects personnel activity
questions.explain_zh: 第29條之7第1款：作業區域超出監視人員目視範圍者，應使勞工佩戴符合CNS 14253-1同等以上規定之全身背負式安全帶及可偵測人員活動情形之裝置；並置備動力或機械輔助吊升之緊急救援設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 29-7(1): a full-body harness meeting CNS 14253-1 and a device that detects activity; powered or mechanical rescue-hoist equipment shall also be provided.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 室內工作場所之主要人行道寬度不得小於多少？各機械間通道不得小於多少？
questions.a_zh: 主要人行道六十公分、機械間五十公分
questions.b_zh: 主要人行道一公尺、機械間八十公分
questions.c_zh: 主要人行道一．五公尺、機械間一公尺
questions.d_zh: 主要人行道八十公分、機械間六十公分
questions.q_en: In indoor workplaces, the minimum widths of main walkways and passages between machines are:
questions.explain_zh: 第31條：主要人行道不得小於一公尺；各機械間或其他設備間通道不得小於八十公分；自路面起算二公尺高度範圍內不得有障礙物。
questions.explain_en: Article 31: main walkways at least 1 m; passages between machines or equipment at least 80 cm; no obstacles within 2 m above the floor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 車輛通行道寬度應如何計算？
questions.a_zh: 最大車輛寬度之二倍再加一公尺；單行道為最大車輛寬度加一公尺
questions.c_zh: 最大車輛寬度加五十公分
questions.q_en: How wide must a vehicle passage be?
questions.a_en: Twice the widest vehicle plus 1 m; one-way lanes the widest vehicle plus 1 m
questions.explain_zh: 第33條：車輛通行道寬度應為最大車輛寬度之二倍再加一公尺，如係單行道則為最大車輛之寬度加一公尺；通行道上禁止放置物品。
questions.explain_en: Article 33: twice the width of the largest vehicle plus 1 m; for one-way passages, the largest vehicle's width plus 1 m; nothing may be placed on the passage.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 設置於緊急避難用出口或通道之門，應為何種型式？
questions.q_en: Doors at emergency exits or escape routes shall be:
questions.explain_zh: 第34條第2項：設置於緊急避難用出口或通道之門，應為外開式。
questions.explain_en: Article 34(2): doors at emergency exits or passages shall open outward.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 架設之通道傾斜應保持在幾度以下？傾斜超過幾度應設置踏條或防滑措施？
questions.b_zh: 三十度以下；超過十五度
questions.c_zh: 四十五度以下；超過三十度
questions.d_zh: 六十度以下；超過四十五度
questions.q_en: An erected walkway's slope shall not exceed how many degrees, and above what slope are cleats or anti-slip measures required?
questions.explain_zh: 第36條：通道傾斜應保持在三十度以下（設樓梯或高度未滿二公尺設有扶手者除外）；傾斜超過十五度以上者應設置踏條或防滑措施；有墜落之虞應設七十五公分以上扶手。
questions.explain_en: Article 36: slope not over 30° (except with stairs, or under 2 m high with handrails); cleats or anti-slip measures above 15°; handrails at least 75 cm high where there is a fall risk.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 固定梯之頂端應突出板面多少公分以上？梯長連續超過六公尺時，每隔幾公尺以下應設一平台？
questions.q_en: A fixed ladder's top shall extend at least how far above the landing, and for ladders over 6 m a platform is required at most every:
questions.explain_zh: 第37條：梯之頂端應突出板面六十公分以上；梯長連續超過六公尺時應每隔九公尺以下設一平台，並於距梯底二公尺以上部分設置護籠或其他保護裝置；踏條與牆壁淨距十六點五公分以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 37: the top shall extend at least 60 cm above the landing; ladders continuously longer than 6 m need a platform at intervals of 9 m or less and a cage from 2 m above the base; rungs at least 16.5 cm clear of the wall.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 以傾斜路代替樓梯時，傾斜路之斜度不得大於幾度？
questions.q_en: When a ramp replaces stairs, its slope shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第38條：傾斜路之斜度不得大於二十度，表面應以粗糙不滑之材料製造。
questions.explain_en: Article 38: the ramp slope shall not exceed 20°, and its surface shall be made of rough, non-slip material.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何種機械依設施規則第41條，應具安全構造並依機械設備器具安全標準辦理？
questions.q_en: Which machine must have a safe structure per the Machinery, Equipment and Tools Safety Standards under Article 41?
questions.explain_zh: 第41條列舉：動力衝剪機械、手推刨床、木材加工用圓盤鋸、動力堆高機、研磨機、研磨輪、防爆電氣設備及相關安全裝置等。
questions.explain_en: Article 41 lists power shearing/punching machines, hand-fed planers, woodworking circular saws, powered forklifts, grinders, grinding wheels, explosion-proof electrical equipment and related safety devices.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 機械之原動機、轉軸、齒輪、帶輪、飛輪、傳動帶等有危害勞工之虞之部分，應有何種設備？
questions.q_en: Hazardous parts of machines such as prime movers, shafts, gears, pulleys, flywheels and belts shall be provided with:
questions.a_en: Guards, enclosures, sleeves, crossover bridges, etc.
questions.explain_zh: 第43條：雇主對於機械之原動機、轉軸、齒輪、帶輪、飛輪、傳動輪、傳動帶等有危害勞工之虞之部分，應有護罩、護圍、套胴、跨橋等設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 43: such parts shall be provided with guards, enclosures, sleeves, crossover bridges and similar equipment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主應於每一具機械分別設置何種裝置？
questions.d_zh: 開關、離合器、移帶裝置等動力遮斷裝置
questions.q_en: What shall be installed separately on each machine?
questions.d_en: A power cut-off device such as a switch, clutch or belt shifter
questions.explain_zh: 第44條：雇主應於每一具機械分別設置開關、離合器、移帶裝置等動力遮斷裝置；切斷、引伸、壓縮等加工機械之遮斷裝置應置於勞工無須離開崗位即可操作之場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 44: each machine shall have its own power cut-off device (switch, clutch, belt shifter); for cutting, drawing or pressing machines it must be operable without leaving the work position.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 動力傳動裝置之軸承，運轉中是否可以注油？
questions.c_zh: 禁止，但有安全注油裝置者不在此限
questions.q_en: May bearings of power transmission devices be oiled while running?
questions.c_en: No, unless a safe lubrication device is provided
questions.explain_zh: 第46條：動力傳動裝置之軸承應有適當之潤滑，運轉中禁止注油。但有安全注油裝置者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 46: bearings shall be properly lubricated; oiling during operation is prohibited unless a safe lubrication device is installed.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 離地幾公尺以內之傳動帶，附近有勞工工作或通行而有接觸危險者，應裝置圍柵或護網？
questions.q_en: Belts within how many meters of the floor with a risk of contact shall be fenced or guarded?
questions.explain_zh: 第49條第1款：離地二公尺以內之傳動帶或附近有勞工工作或通行而有接觸危險者，應裝置適當之圍柵或護網。
questions.explain_en: Article 49(1): belts within 2 m of the floor, or where workers work or pass nearby with contact risk, shall have suitable fences or guard nets.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 對於鑽孔機、截角機等旋轉刃具作業，勞工手指有觸及之虞者，雇主應明確告知及標示勞工不得使用何物？
questions.q_en: For rotating-blade work such as drilling machines, workers whose fingers may contact the blade must be told and signs posted NOT to use:
questions.explain_zh: 第56條：對於鑽孔機、截角機等旋轉刃具作業，勞工手指有觸及之虞者，應明確告知及標示勞工不得使用手套，並使勞工確實遵守。
questions.explain_en: Article 56: workers shall be clearly informed and signs posted that gloves must not be used, and the employer shall ensure compliance.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 機械之掃除、上油、檢查、修理有導致危害之虞時，應採取下列何種措施？
questions.a_zh: 加快作業速度以縮短時間
questions.d_zh: 停止運轉及送料、上鎖及設置標示防止誤操作、設置防止落下物之設備
questions.q_en: When cleaning, oiling, inspecting or repairing machinery could cause harm, the employer shall:
questions.a_en: Work faster to shorten the time
questions.d_en: Stop operation and feeding, lock out and tag to prevent mis-operation, and install protection against falling objects
questions.explain_zh: 第57條第1項：停止相關機械運轉及送料；上鎖及設置標示等措施，防止誤操作起動裝置或誤送料；設置防止落下物導致危害之安全設備。第2項並應訂定危害防止計畫。
questions.explain_en: Article 57(1): stop the machine and feeding; lock out and tag to prevent accidental start-up or feeding; provide safety equipment against falling objects. Paragraph 2 requires a hazard prevention plan.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 研磨機應於每日作業開始前試轉多久以上？更換研磨輪時應在防護罩下試轉多久以上？
questions.q_en: A grinder shall be test-run for at least how long before daily work, and after changing the wheel?
questions.explain_zh: 第62條第1項第4款：研磨機使用應於每日作業開始前試轉一分鐘以上，研磨輪更換時應先檢驗有無裂痕，並在防護罩下試轉三分鐘以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 62(1)(4): test-run at least 1 minute before daily work; after changing the wheel, check for cracks and test-run at least 3 minutes under the guard.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 研磨輪之速率試驗應按最高使用周速度增加多少為之？直徑不滿多少公分之研磨輪得免予速率試驗？
questions.a_zh: 增加百分之百；二十公分
questions.c_zh: 增加百分之五十；十公分
questions.d_zh: 增加百分之二十；十五公分
questions.q_en: The speed test of a grinding wheel is done at the maximum operating peripheral speed increased by what percentage, and wheels under what diameter are exempt?
questions.explain_zh: 第62條第2項：速率試驗應按最高使用周速度增加百分之五十為之。直徑不滿十公分之研磨輪得免予速率試驗。
questions.explain_en: Article 62(2): the speed test is performed at 150% of the maximum operating peripheral speed; wheels with diameter under 10 cm are exempt.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用水柱壓力達每平方公分多少公斤以上之高壓水切割裝置，應訂定安全衛生作業標準並指定專人指揮監督？
questions.q_en: High-pressure water cutting devices with water pressure of at least how much require a safety work standard and a designated supervisor?
questions.explain_zh: 第63條之1：使用水柱壓力達每平方公分三百五十公斤以上之高壓水切割裝置，從事沖蝕、剝離、切除等作業，應事前訂定安全衛生作業標準，指定專人指揮監督，並提供個人防護具。
questions.explain_en: Article 63-1: devices with water jet pressure of 350 kg/cm² or more require a pre-established safety work standard, a designated supervisor and personal protective equipment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 設置固定式圓盤鋸、帶鋸、手推刨床、截角機等木材加工機械合計幾台以上時，應指定作業管理人員？
questions.q_en: When five or more woodworking machines (circular saws, band saws, planers, etc.) are installed, the employer shall designate:
questions.c_en: An operations manager at five or more machines
questions.explain_zh: 第68條：設置固定式圓盤鋸、帶鋸、手推刨床、截角機等合計五台以上時，應指定作業管理人員負責指揮操作、檢查機械及安全裝置、監視送料工具使用情形等。第72條衝剪機械五台以上亦同。
questions.explain_en: Article 68: with five or more such machines, an operations manager shall be designated to direct operation, inspect machines and safety devices, and monitor use of feeding tools. Article 72 applies the same to five or more press/shear machines.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工從事動力衝剪機械金屬模之安裝、拆模、調整及試模時，為防止滑塊突降，應使用何種裝置？
questions.d_zh: 安全塊、安全插梢或安全開關鎖匙
questions.q_en: When installing, removing, adjusting or testing dies on a power press, what must workers use to prevent the slide from dropping?
questions.d_en: Safety blocks, safety pins or safety switch keys
questions.explain_zh: 第69條：為防止滑塊等突降之危害，應使勞工使用安全塊、安全插梢或安全開關鎖匙等裝置；勞工應確實使用。
questions.explain_en: Article 69: workers shall use safety blocks, safety plugs/pins or safety switch keys to prevent sudden descent of the slide, and must actually use them.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 離心機械應裝置何種裝置，使覆蓋未完全關閉時無法啟動？
questions.q_en: Centrifugal machines shall be fitted with what so they cannot start unless the cover is fully closed?
questions.c_en: A cover and an interlock device
questions.explain_zh: 第73條：雇主對於離心機械，應裝置覆蓋及連鎖裝置；連鎖裝置應使覆蓋未完全關閉時無法啟動。
questions.explain_en: Article 73: centrifugal machines shall have a cover and an interlock that prevents starting when the cover is not fully closed.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 為防止勞工自粉碎機及混合機之開口部分墜落，設置之圍柵高度應在多少公分以上？
questions.q_en: To prevent falls into crushers or mixers, guard fences shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第76條：雇主應有覆蓋、護圍、高度在九十公分以上之圍柵等必要設備。但設置有阻礙作業且勞工佩戴安全帶或安全索者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 76: covers, enclosures or fences at least 90 cm high are required, unless they obstruct work and workers wear safety harnesses or lines.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 施行週邊速率超過每秒多少公尺之高速回轉體試驗時，應於專用堅固建築物內或以堅固隔牆隔離之場所實施？
questions.q_en: Tests of high-speed rotating bodies with peripheral speed exceeding what value must be done in a dedicated sturdy building or behind a solid partition?
questions.explain_zh: 第84條：旋轉輪機、離心分離機等週邊速率超越每秒二十五公尺以上之高速回轉體之試驗，應於專用堅固建築物內或以堅固隔牆隔離之場所實施。第85條：轉軸超過一公噸且週邊速率每秒一百二十公尺以上者，應先施行非破壞檢查。
questions.explain_en: Article 84: peripheral speeds over 25 m/s require a dedicated sturdy building or solid partition; Article 85: shafts over 1 tonne with peripheral speed of 120 m/s or more require non-destructive inspection first.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主對於起重機具之作業，應規定一定之運轉指揮信號，並如何辦理？
questions.q_en: For crane operations, the employer shall establish fixed operating signals and:
questions.b_en: Designate a specific person to give them
questions.explain_zh: 第88條：雇主對於起重機具之作業，應規定一定之運轉指揮信號，並指派專人負責辦理。
questions.explain_en: Article 88: the employer shall prescribe fixed operating signals for lifting equipment and designate a person responsible for them.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 起重機具之吊鉤或吊具，為防止與吊架或捲揚胴接觸，其過捲預防裝置應至少保持多少公尺距離？直動式者為多少？
questions.q_en: The over-hoist prevention device of a crane hook shall keep at least what distance from the hoist frame or drum, and for direct-acting devices?
questions.explain_zh: 第91條：應有至少保持○．二五公尺距離之過捲預防裝置，如為直動式過捲預防裝置者，應保持○．○五公尺以上距離；並於鋼索上作顯著標示或設警報裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 91: at least 0.25 m; for direct-acting over-hoist prevention devices at least 0.05 m; with conspicuous marks on the wire rope or an alarm device.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 升降機之升降路各樓出入口門應有連鎖裝置，使搬器地板與樓板相差多少公分以上時，出入口門不能開啟？
questions.q_en: Elevator landing doors shall have an interlock preventing opening when the car floor differs from the landing by more than:
questions.explain_zh: 第95條：雇主對於升降機之升降路各樓出入口門，應有連鎖裝置，使搬器地板與樓板相差七．五公分以上時，升降路出入口門不能開啟之。
questions.explain_en: Article 95: landing doors shall have an interlock so they cannot open when the car floor and landing differ by 7.5 cm or more.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 起重機具所使用之吊鉤或鉤環及附屬零件，其斷裂荷重與所承受最大荷重比之安全係數應在多少以上？
questions.q_en: The safety factor (breaking load ÷ maximum load) of crane hooks, shackles and fittings shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第97條：吊鉤或鉤環及附屬零件，其斷裂荷重與所承受之最大荷重比之安全係數，應在四以上。但相關法規另有規定者，從其規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 97: the safety factor of hooks, shackles and fittings shall be 4 or more, unless other regulations provide otherwise.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何種情況之吊鏈不得作為起重升降機具之吊掛用具？
questions.a_zh: 延伸長度超過百分之五以上
questions.d_zh: 延伸長度超過百分之一
questions.q_en: Which chain must NOT be used as a lifting sling?
questions.b_en: Slight oil stains on the surface
questions.explain_zh: 第98條：延伸長度超過百分之五以上、斷面直徑減少百分之十以上、有龜裂者，不得作為吊掛用具。
questions.explain_en: Article 98: chains with elongation over 5%, cross-section diameter reduced by 10% or more, or cracks shall not be used.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 吊掛用鋼索，鋼索一撚間有百分之多少以上素線截斷者不得使用？直徑減少達公稱直徑百分之多少以上者不得使用？
questions.c_zh: 百分之二十；百分之十五
questions.q_en: A lifting wire rope must not be used when broken wires in one lay exceed what percentage, or when diameter is reduced by what percentage of nominal?
questions.explain_zh: 第99條：鋼索一撚間有百分之十以上素線截斷者、直徑減少達公稱直徑百分之七以上者、有顯著變形或腐蝕者、已扭結者，不得作為吊掛用具。
questions.explain_en: Article 99: 10% or more broken wires in one lay; diameter reduced by 7% or more of nominal; significant deformation or corrosion; kinked ropes are all prohibited.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 纖維索、帶有何種情形，不得作為起重升降機具之吊掛用具？
questions.q_en: A fiber rope or sling must not be used for lifting when:
questions.explain_zh: 第101條：已斷一股子索者、有顯著之損傷或腐蝕者，不得使用。
questions.explain_en: Article 101: fiber ropes with one broken strand, or with significant damage or corrosion, shall not be used.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 搬運高壓氣體容器時，溫度應保持在攝氏幾度以下？
questions.q_en: When transporting high-pressure gas cylinders, the temperature shall be kept below:
questions.explain_zh: 第107條第1款：溫度保持在攝氏四十度以下。另容器吊起搬運不得直接用電磁鐵、吊鏈、繩子等直接吊運；裝卸車應確知護蓋旋緊。
questions.explain_en: Article 107(1): keep below 40°C; cylinders must not be lifted directly with electromagnets, chains or ropes; caps must be tightened before loading/unloading.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高壓氣體貯存場所周圍幾公尺內不得放置煙火及著火性、引火性物品？
questions.q_en: Within how many meters of a high-pressure gas storage area are fire, ignitable and flammable items prohibited?
questions.explain_zh: 第108條第2款：貯存周圍二公尺內不得放置有煙火及著火性、引火性物品。另可燃性、毒性及氧氣鋼瓶應分開貯存；通路面積以貯存處面積百分之二十以上為原則。
questions.explain_en: Article 108(2): within 2 m. Flammable, toxic and oxygen cylinders shall be stored separately; aisles should be at least 20% of the storage area.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高壓氣體貯存，可燃性氣體、有毒性氣體及氧氣之鋼瓶應如何處理？
questions.d_zh: 可混合貯存以節省空間
questions.q_en: Cylinders of flammable gas, toxic gas and oxygen shall be:
questions.explain_zh: 第108條第4款：可燃性氣體、有毒性氣體及氧氣之鋼瓶，應分開貯存；盛裝容器和空容器亦應分區放置。
questions.explain_en: Article 108(4): flammable, toxic and oxygen cylinders shall be stored separately; full and empty cylinders shall also be placed in separate zones.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 車輛系營建機械及堆高機，除乘坐席位外，於作業時是否得搭載勞工？
questions.q_en: May workers ride on vehicle-type construction machinery or forklifts other than in seats?
questions.explain_zh: 第116條第2款：車輛系營建機械及堆高機，除乘坐席位外，於作業時不得搭載勞工。第10款並禁止勞工搭載於堆高機貨叉之托板等部分。
questions.explain_en: Article 116(2): apart from seats, no workers may ride during operation; item 10 also prohibits riding on forklift pallets or forks.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 堆高機駕駛者離開其位置時，應採取何種措施？
questions.a_zh: 將貨叉等放置於地面，並將原動機熄火、制動
questions.c_zh: 將貨叉升至最高以免絆倒
questions.d_zh: 保持引擎運轉以便隨時使用
questions.q_en: When a forklift driver leaves the seat, the driver shall:
questions.a_en: Lower the forks to the ground, shut off the engine and apply the brake
questions.c_en: Raise the forks to the top
questions.d_en: Keep the engine running for quick use
questions.explain_zh: 第116條第12款：堆高機於駕駛者離開其位置時，應採將貨叉等放置於地面，並將原動機熄火、制動。第11款車輛機械亦應將吊斗等作業裝置放置於地面、熄火、制動。
questions.explain_en: Article 116(12): lower the forks to the ground, shut off the engine and apply the brake; item 11 requires the same for other vehicle machines (buckets to the ground).

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用座式操作之配衡型堆高機及側舉型堆高機，駕駛勞工應確實使用何種裝備？
questions.q_en: Drivers of seated counterbalance or side-loading forklifts shall use:
questions.explain_zh: 第116條第14款：使用座式操作之配衡型堆高機及側舉型堆高機，應使擔任駕駛之勞工確實使用駕駛座安全帶。但駕駛座配置有防止翻倒壓傷之護欄或其他防護設施者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 116(14): drivers of seated counterbalance and side-loader forklifts shall wear the seat belt, unless the seat has a guard rail or other protection against being crushed in a tip-over.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 最大速率超過每小時多少公里之車輛系營建機械，應事前依地質地形規定行駛速率？
questions.q_en: For vehicle-type construction machinery with a maximum speed exceeding what, must the employer set travel speeds in advance based on terrain?
questions.explain_zh: 第117條：最大速率超過每小時十公里之車輛系營建機械，應於事前依相關作業場所之地質、地形等狀況，規定車輛行駛速率，並使勞工依該速率進行作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 117: for machines with maximum speed over 10 km/h, travel speed shall be prescribed in advance based on the geology and terrain of the site.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用於作業場所之車輛系營建機械，應設置何種裝置以防止物體掉落之危害？
questions.q_en: Vehicle-type construction machinery used on site shall be equipped with what to protect against falling objects?
questions.explain_zh: 第119條：駕駛棚須有良好視線與通風、裝置前照燈、設置堅固頂蓬、制動裝置、裝設倒車或旋轉之警報裝置或人員偵測警示設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 119: good cab visibility and ventilation, headlights, a sturdy canopy, brakes, and reversing/rotation alarms or personnel-detection warning equipment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 車輛系營建機械作業有翻落、表土崩塌之虞者，雇主事先決定之事項中，應告知作業勞工者為何？
questions.q_en: When vehicle-type construction machinery may overturn or cause surface collapse, which pre-decided items must be told to workers?
questions.explain_zh: 第120條：應事先調查地質、地形，決定機械種類及性能、行經路線、作業方法、整理工作場所，並將第二款（行經路線）及第三款（作業方法）告知作業勞工。
questions.explain_en: Article 120: after surveying geology and terrain, decide machine type/performance, travel routes, work methods and site preparation; routes and methods shall be told to workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 堆高機非置備何種裝置者不得使用？
questions.q_en: A forklift must not be used unless it is equipped with a:
questions.explain_zh: 第124條：堆高機非置備有後扶架者，不得使用。但將桅桿後傾之際，雖有貨物之掉落亦不致危害勞工者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 124: forklifts without a load backrest shall not be used, unless load falling during mast tilt-back poses no hazard.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 荷重在多少公噸以上之堆高機，應指派經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作？
questions.q_en: Forklifts with a load capacity of at least how much must be operated by persons who completed special operation safety training?
questions.explain_zh: 第126條：雇主對於荷重在一公噸以上之堆高機，應指派經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作。
questions.explain_en: Article 126: forklifts with a load of 1 tonne or more shall be operated by personnel trained in special operation safety and health.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用高空工作車從事作業時，工作台上之勞工應佩戴何種防護具？
questions.a_zh: 安全帽及全身背負式安全帶
questions.q_en: Workers on the platform of an aerial work platform vehicle shall wear:
questions.a_en: A helmet and a full-body harness
questions.explain_zh: 第128條之1第7款：應使工作台上之勞工佩戴安全帽及符合CNS 14253-1同等以上規定之全身背負式安全帶。另應訂定作業計畫、外伸撐座完全伸出、不得超過積載荷重。
questions.explain_en: Article 128-1(7): a helmet and a full-body harness meeting CNS 14253-1; also a work plan, fully extended outriggers, and no overloading.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 為防止高空工作車翻倒或翻落，除行駛於道路上外，其外伸撐座應如何？
questions.c_zh: 完全伸出，並防止地盤不均勻沉陷
questions.q_en: To prevent an aerial work platform vehicle from overturning (other than when driving on roads), its outriggers shall be:
questions.c_en: Fully extended, with measures against uneven ground settlement
questions.explain_zh: 第128條之1第2款：應將其外伸撐座完全伸出，並採取防止地盤不均勻沉陷、路肩崩塌等必要措施。但具有多段伸出之外伸撐座者，得依原廠設計之允許外伸長度作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 128-1(2): outriggers shall be fully extended with measures against uneven settlement or shoulder collapse; multi-stage outriggers may follow the manufacturer's allowed extension.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高空工作車之駕駛離開駕駛座時（工作台無人作業），應採取何種措施？
questions.b_zh: 保持工作台於作業高度
questions.c_zh: 將工作台下降至最低位置，並採取預防逸走措施
questions.q_en: When the driver of an aerial work platform vehicle leaves the seat (no one on the platform), the driver shall:
questions.b_en: Keep the platform at working height
questions.c_en: Lower the platform to its lowest position and prevent runaway (engine off, brake applied)
questions.explain_zh: 第128條之2：駕駛離開駕駛座時應將工作台下降至最低位置，並採取停止原動機、確實使用制動裝置等預防逸走措施。但有勞工在工作台作業時不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 128-2: lower the platform to the lowest position, stop the engine and apply the brake to prevent runaway, except when workers are on the platform.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高空工作車應指派何種人員操作？
questions.b_zh: 經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員
questions.q_en: Aerial work platform vehicles shall be operated by:
questions.b_en: Personnel trained in special operation safety and health
questions.explain_zh: 第128條之9：雇主對於高空工作車，應指派經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作。
questions.explain_en: Article 128-9: the employer shall assign personnel who completed special operation safety and health training.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 藉捲揚裝置行駛之軌道車輛，其捲揚鋼索安全係數，載貨者與載人者分別應在多少以上？
questions.q_en: For rail vehicles hauled by a winch, the wire rope safety factor for cargo and for passengers shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第144條第2款：捲揚鋼索之斷裂荷重與所承受最大荷重比之安全係數，載貨者應在六以上，載人者應在十以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 144(2): safety factor at least 6 for cargo vehicles and at least 10 for passenger vehicles.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 軌道手推車於下坡行駛時，車輛間應保持多少公尺以上間距？速率不得超過每小時幾公里？
questions.q_en: Rail handcarts travelling downhill shall keep what spacing, and not exceed what speed?
questions.explain_zh: 第150條：車輛於上坡或水平行駛時應保持六公尺以上間距，下坡行駛時應保持二十公尺以上間距；下坡速率不得超過每小時十五公里。
questions.explain_en: Article 150: at least 6 m spacing on level or uphill, 20 m downhill; downhill speed not over 15 km/h.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使勞工進入供儲存大量物料之槽桶時，下列何者為正確作法？
questions.a_zh: 由下方開口進入為原則
questions.b_zh: 事先測定確認無爆炸、中毒及缺氧危險，佩掛安全帶，進口處派人監視
questions.q_en: When workers enter a tank storing large quantities of material, the correct practice is:
questions.a_en: Enter from the bottom opening as a rule
questions.b_en: Test in advance for explosion, poisoning and oxygen deficiency, wear a harness, and post a watcher at the entrance
questions.explain_zh: 第154條：應事先測定並確認無爆炸、中毒及缺氧等危險；使勞工佩掛安全帶及安全索；於進口處派人監視以備營救；規定以由槽桶上方進入為原則。
questions.explain_en: Article 154: test and confirm no explosion, poisoning or oxygen-deficiency hazard; wear a harness and lifeline; station a watcher at the entrance; enter from the top as a rule.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 依設施規則第155條，多少公斤以上物品以人力車輛或工具搬運為原則？多少公斤以上以機動車輛或其他機械搬運為宜？
questions.q_en: Under Article 155, items of what weight should be moved with hand carts or tools, and what weight with powered vehicles or machinery?
questions.explain_zh: 第155條：物料之搬運應儘量利用機械以代替人力，凡四十公斤以上物品以人力車輛或工具搬運為原則，五百公斤以上物品以機動車輛或其他機械搬運為宜。
questions.explain_en: Article 155: items of 40 kg or more should be moved by hand carts or tools; 500 kg or more by powered vehicles or other machinery.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 以捲揚機等吊運物料時，下列何者正確？
questions.c_zh: 可供人員搭乘以節省時間
questions.d_zh: 不得供人員搭乘、吊升或降落；應設防止過捲裝置；設置信號指揮人員
questions.q_en: When hoisting materials with a winch, which is correct?
questions.a_en: Working under power lines is fine
questions.c_en: Persons may ride to save time
questions.d_en: No riding, lifting or lowering of persons; an over-hoist prevention device; a signal person
questions.explain_zh: 第155條之1：不得供人員搭乘、吊升或降落（臨時緊急處理經採防墜措施及專人監督者除外）；吊鉤應有防止脫落裝置；嚴禁人員進入吊掛物下方；應設防止過捲裝置；設置信號指揮聯絡人員；避免鄰近電力線作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 155-1: no persons may ride or be hoisted (except emergencies with fall protection and supervision); hooks need anti-slip devices; no one under the load; over-hoist prevention; a signal person; avoid working near power lines.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 物料積垛作業，作業地點高差在多少公尺以上時，應設置安全上下設備？高差在多少公尺以上時，應指定專人指揮？
questions.q_en: In material stacking work, safe access equipment is required at a height difference of at least how much, and a designated supervisor at least how much?
questions.explain_zh: 第161條：作業地點高差在一．五公尺以上時應設置使勞工能安全上下之設備；高差在二．五公尺以上時，並應指定專人決定作業方法、檢點工具、指示安全事項及監督作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 161: safe means of access at 1.5 m or more; at 2.5 m or more a designated person shall decide methods, inspect tools, instruct on safety and supervise.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高度二公尺以上之袋裝容器積垛拆垛時，應使成階梯狀，除最底階外其餘各階高度應在多少以下？
questions.q_en: When dismantling bagged-material stacks over 2 m high, they shall be stepped so that each step (except the bottom) is no higher than:
questions.explain_zh: 第163條：不得自積垛物料中間抽出物料；拆除袋裝容器構成之積垛應使成階梯狀，除最底階外，其餘各階之高度應在一．五公尺以下。
questions.explain_en: Article 163: do not pull materials from the middle; step the stack so each step except the bottom is 1.5 m or less.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工於載貨台從事單一重量超過多少公斤之物料裝卸時，應指定專人指揮監督？
questions.q_en: Loading or unloading single items heavier than what on a truck bed requires a designated supervisor?
questions.explain_zh: 第167條：於載貨台從事單一之重量超越一百公斤以上物料裝卸時，應指定專人決定作業方法及順序、檢點工具、禁止無關人員進入、確認貨物無墜落危險、監督作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 167: for single items over 100 kg, a designated person shall decide methods, inspect tools, keep others away, check for falling risk and supervise.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高煙囪及高度在幾公尺以上並作為危險物品倉庫使用之建築物，應裝設避雷裝置？
questions.q_en: Tall chimneys and buildings of at least what height used as hazardous-material warehouses require lightning protection?
questions.explain_zh: 第170條：雇主對於高煙囪及高度在三公尺以上並作為危險物品倉庫使用之建築物，均應裝設適當避雷裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 170: tall chimneys and buildings 3 m or higher used as hazardous-material warehouses shall have suitable lightning protection.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 從事熔接、熔斷等使用明火之作業時，不得以何種氣體供為通風或換氣之用？
questions.q_en: During welding, cutting or other open-flame work, which gas must NOT be used for ventilation?
questions.explain_zh: 第174條：從事熔接、熔斷、金屬之加熱及其他須使用明火之作業或有發生火花之虞之作業時，不得以氧氣供為通風或換氣之用。
questions.explain_en: Article 174: oxygen shall not be used for ventilation during welding, cutting, metal heating or other open-flame or spark-producing work.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 作業場所之易燃液體蒸氣或可燃性氣體濃度達爆炸下限值百分之多少以上時，應即刻使勞工退避並停止使用煙火？
questions.q_en: Workers must be evacuated and ignition sources stopped when flammable vapor or gas reaches what percentage of the lower explosive limit?
questions.explain_zh: 第177條第1項第2款：蒸氣或氣體之濃度達爆炸下限值之百分之三十以上時，應即刻使勞工退避至安全場所，停止使用煙火及其他點火源，並加強通風。作業前應指定專人測定濃度。
questions.explain_en: Article 177(1)(2): at 30% or more of the LEL, evacuate workers, stop fire and ignition sources and increase ventilation; a designated person shall measure concentrations before work.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用槽車從事灌注或卸收危險物作業前，應採取何種措施？
questions.a_zh: 保持引擎運轉以便隨時移動
questions.b_zh: 槽車引擎熄火並設置輪擋
questions.q_en: Before loading or unloading hazardous materials with a tank truck, the employer shall:
questions.b_en: Shut off the engine and place wheel chocks
questions.explain_zh: 第179條之1第5款：使用槽車從事灌注或卸收作業前，槽車之引擎應熄火，且設置適當之輪擋，以防止作業時車輛移動；作業結束並確認安全後始得發動。
questions.explain_en: Article 179-1(5): the tank truck engine shall be shut off and wheel chocks placed to prevent movement; restart only after confirming safety at the end.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 危險物製造、處置之工作場所，對於爆炸性物質應如何處理？
questions.b_zh: 置於高溫處以保持乾燥
questions.d_zh: 遠離煙火或發火源，並不得加熱、摩擦、衝擊
questions.q_en: In workplaces handling hazardous materials, explosive substances shall be:
questions.b_en: Kept in hot places to stay dry
questions.c_en: Left anywhere in the work area
questions.d_en: Kept away from fire and ignition sources, and not heated, rubbed or struck
questions.explain_zh: 第184條第1款：爆炸性物質應遠離煙火或有發火源之虞之物，並不得加熱、摩擦、衝擊。氧化性物質不得接觸促進分解之物質；易燃液體未經許可不得灌注、蒸發或加熱。
questions.explain_en: Article 184(1): explosives shall be kept away from fire and ignition sources and not heated, rubbed or struck; oxidizers must not contact decomposition promoters; flammable liquids must not be poured, evaporated or heated without permission.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主對於常溫下具自燃性之四氫化矽（矽甲烷）之處理，除依高壓氣體及消防法規外，應於作業前辦理何事？其紀錄留存幾年？
questions.b_zh: 向消防局申請許可；五年
questions.c_zh: 依中央主管機關指引實施風險評估並製作報告；三年
questions.q_en: For handling silane (SiH4), which is pyrophoric at room temperature, what must the employer do before work, and how long are records kept?
questions.b_en: Apply to the fire department; 5 years
questions.c_en: Conduct a risk assessment per the central authority's guidelines and prepare a report; 3 years
questions.explain_zh: 第185條之1：作業前應依中央主管機關公告之指引，就製程危害、防止設備、維護方法、緊急應變實施風險評估並製作報告；設置氣體洩漏檢知警報系統、流率限制孔、氣瓶櫃、灑水設備等，並留存紀錄三年。硝酸銨、有機過氧化物、熱媒油亦有類似規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 185-1: a pre-work risk assessment report (process hazards, prevention equipment, maintenance, emergency response), leak detection alarms, flow-restricting orifices, gas cabinets, sprinklers, with records kept 3 years. Similar rules cover ammonium nitrate, organic peroxides and heat-transfer oil.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 工作場所實施加油作業時，下列何者正確？
questions.b_zh: 發動中加油可節省時間
questions.c_zh: 禁止以汽油為燃料之內燃機在發動中加油
questions.d_zh: 可將油料溢濺於排氣管附近
questions.q_en: During refueling in the workplace, which is correct?
questions.c_en: Gasoline-powered engines must not be refueled while running
questions.d_en: Spilling fuel near the exhaust is acceptable
questions.explain_zh: 第187條：禁止以汽油為燃料之內燃機等機械在發動中加油；設置顯著之危險警告標示；備置化學乾粉、泡沫或二氧化碳等適當之油類用滅火器材；避免油料溢濺於引擎、排氣管或電氣設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 187: gasoline engines must not be refueled while running; post hazard warnings; provide dry chemical, foam or CO2 extinguishers; avoid spills on engines, exhausts or electrical equipment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 熔接用可燃性氣體及氧氣之容器，使用時應留置何物於容器閥柄上，以備緊急時遮斷氣源？
questions.q_en: When using welding gas or oxygen cylinders, what must be left on the cylinder valve for emergency shut-off?
questions.explain_zh: 第190條第4款：容器使用時，應留置專用板手於容器閥柄上，以備緊急時遮斷氣源。另應保持四十度以下、直立穩妥放置、搬運時裝妥護蓋、不得接觸電焊器電路火源。
questions.explain_en: Article 190(4): a dedicated wrench shall be kept on the valve stem for emergency shut-off; cylinders shall be kept below 40°C, upright, capped during transport, and away from welders, circuits and fire.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 化學設備之改善、修理、清掃等作業，為防止危險物洩漏，應將閥或旋塞如何處理？
questions.b_zh: 雙重關閉或設置盲板，並加鎖、鉛封或拆離把手
questions.q_en: During repair or cleaning of chemical equipment, valves or cocks shall be:
questions.b_en: Double-closed or blanked off, and locked, sealed or handles removed
questions.explain_zh: 第198條：應將閥或旋塞雙重關閉或設置盲板；並加鎖、鉛封或將把手拆離，使其無法擅動，設有不准開啟之標示或監視人員。拆除盲板前應確認無殘留物質。
questions.explain_en: Article 198: double-close valves or install blind flanges; lock, seal or remove handles with a 'do not open' sign or a watcher; confirm no residue before removing blinds.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 處理危險物之乾燥室，原則上應為何種建築？
questions.q_en: A drying room handling hazardous materials shall in principle be:
questions.explain_zh: 第199條：處理危險物之乾燥室應為平房。但設置乾燥室建築物之樓層正上方無樓層或為耐火建築者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 199: single-story, unless there is no floor above or the building is fire-resistant.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用乙炔熔接裝置從事熔接作業時，產生之乙炔壓力不得超過表壓力每平方公分多少公斤？
questions.q_en: When using an acetylene welding apparatus, the acetylene gauge pressure shall not exceed:
questions.explain_zh: 第203條：應規定其產生之乙炔壓力不得超過表壓力每平方公分一點三公斤以上。
questions.explain_en: Article 203: acetylene pressure shall not exceed a gauge pressure of 1.3 kg/cm².

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 乙炔發生器室以置於屋外為原則，其開口部分應與其他建築物保持多少公尺以上距離？
questions.q_en: An acetylene generator room should be outdoors, with its openings at least how far from other buildings?
questions.explain_zh: 第204條：乙炔發生器應有專用發生器室，以置於屋外為原則，開口部分應與其他建築物保持一．五公尺以上之距離；置於屋內者上方不得有樓層。
questions.explain_en: Article 204: a dedicated generator room, preferably outdoors, with openings at least 1.5 m from other buildings; if indoors, no floor above.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 乙炔熔接裝置及氧乙炔熔接裝置，為防止氧氣背壓過高、逆流及回火，應於每一何處設置安全器？
questions.q_en: To prevent oxygen backpressure, backflow and flashback in acetylene welding apparatus, a safety device (flashback arrestor) shall be installed on each:
questions.explain_zh: 第209條：應於每一吹管分別設置安全器。但主管及最近吹管之分岐管分別設有安全器者，不在此限。第212條：使每一吹管有兩個以上之安全器。
questions.explain_en: Article 209: a safety device on each torch, unless both the main line and the nearest branch have one; Article 212 requires two or more per torch on the main and branch lines.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 氣體集合熔接裝置之設置，應選擇於距離用火設備多少公尺以上之場所？
questions.q_en: A gas manifold welding installation shall be located at least how far from fire-using equipment?
questions.explain_zh: 第210條：氣體集合熔接裝置之設置，應選擇於距離用火設備五公尺以上之場所，並設置於專用氣體裝置室內。
questions.explain_en: Article 210: at least 5 m from fire-using equipment, in a dedicated gas equipment room.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 距離乙炔熔接裝置之發生器室幾公尺、距離乙炔發生器及氣體集合裝置幾公尺範圍內，應禁止吸菸及使用煙火？
questions.q_en: Smoking and fire are prohibited within how many meters of an acetylene generator room, and of the generator or gas manifold?
questions.explain_zh: 第214條第3款：距離乙炔熔接裝置之發生器室三公尺、距離乙炔發生器及氣體集合裝置五公尺範圍內，應禁止吸菸、使用煙火或從事有發生火花之虞之作業，並加標示。
questions.explain_en: Article 214(3): within 3 m of the generator room and within 5 m of the generator or gas manifold, with signs posted.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 以乙炔熔接裝置或氣體集合熔接裝置從事金屬熔接、熔斷作業，應指派何種人員操作？
questions.c_zh: 經特殊安全衛生教育訓練合格人員
questions.q_en: Welding or cutting with acetylene or gas manifold welding apparatus shall be performed by:
questions.c_en: Personnel who passed special safety and health training
questions.explain_zh: 第216條：應指派經特殊安全衛生教育、訓練合格人員操作。第217、218條並應選任專人辦理作業指揮、漏洩測試等事項。
questions.explain_en: Article 216: only personnel who completed special safety and health training; Articles 217–218 require a designated person to direct work and test for leaks.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 火藥爆破點火後未爆或難以確認時，使用電氣雷管者應經幾分鐘以上、使用電氣雷管以外者應經幾分鐘以上，始得接近充填地點？
questions.q_en: After a misfire, how long must one wait before approaching the charge with electric detonators, and with non-electric detonators?
questions.explain_zh: 第219條第5款：使用電氣雷管時應卸下發爆母線、短結端部、採取無法再點火措施並經五分鐘以上；使用電氣雷管以外者應經十五分鐘以上，並確認無危險後始得接近。
questions.explain_en: Article 219(5): electric detonators: disconnect the firing line, short the ends, prevent re-firing and wait at least 5 minutes; non-electric: wait at least 15 minutes, then confirm safety.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用導火索方式從事爆破作業，一人之點火數在多少以上時，應使用爆破時間指示器等能獲知退避時間之儀表？
questions.q_en: In fuse blasting, when one person lights how many or more fuses must a blasting timer or similar instrument be used to know the retreat time?
questions.explain_zh: 第221條第3款：一人之點火數在五以上時，應使用爆破時間指示器等能獲知退避時間之儀表。
questions.explain_en: Article 221(3): when one person lights 5 or more fuses, a blasting time indicator or similar instrument must be used.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高度在幾公尺以上之工作場所邊緣及開口部分，勞工有墜落之虞者，應設護欄、護蓋等防護設備？
questions.q_en: Edges and openings of workplaces at least how high require guardrails or covers where workers may fall?
questions.explain_zh: 第224條：高度在二公尺以上之工作場所邊緣及開口部分，勞工有遭受墜落危險之虞者，應設有適當強度之護欄、護蓋等防護設備；顯有困難或臨時拆除時，應使勞工使用安全帶。
questions.explain_en: Article 224: at 2 m or higher, guardrails or covers of adequate strength are required; where impractical or temporarily removed, workers shall use safety harnesses.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高度二公尺以上作業設置工作台有困難時，得採取張掛安全網或使用安全帶；無其他安全替代措施者得採繩索作業，繩索作業應符合何種標準？
questions.q_en: When a work platform is impractical above 2 m and no alternative exists, rope access may be used following which standard?
questions.explain_zh: 第225條：繩索作業應由受過訓練之人員為之，並於高處採用符合國際標準ISO 22846系列或同等標準之作業規定及設備從事工作。
questions.explain_en: Article 225: rope access shall be done by trained personnel following ISO 22846 series or equivalent standards for procedures and equipment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 高度二公尺以上之作業場所遇強風、大雨等惡劣氣候致有墜落危險時，雇主應如何？
questions.q_en: At work areas 2 m or higher, in strong wind or heavy rain with fall risk, the employer shall:
questions.c_en: Add workers to rush the job
questions.explain_zh: 第226條：對於高度在二公尺以上之作業場所，有遇強風、大雨等惡劣氣候致勞工有墜落危險時，應使勞工停止作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 226: work shall be stopped when severe weather such as strong wind or heavy rain creates a fall risk at heights of 2 m or more.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 於石綿板、鐵皮板等易踏穿材料構築之屋頂作業時，應設置寬度多少公分以上之踏板，並指定何人監督？
questions.a_zh: 三十公分；屋頂作業主管
questions.q_en: On roofs of fragile materials such as asbestos or metal sheets, walkboards of what minimum width are required and who supervises?
questions.explain_zh: 第227條：規劃安全通道，於屋架上設置適當強度且寬度在三十公分以上之踏板；下方裝設堅固格柵或安全網；指定屋頂作業主管指揮或監督該作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 227: plan safe routes with walkboards at least 30 cm wide on the roof frame, install grilles or safety nets below, and designate a roof work supervisor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 新建、增建工廠之鋼構屋頂，於邊緣及屋頂突出物頂板周圍應設置高度多少公分以上之女兒牆或適當強度欄杆？
questions.q_en: On steel-structure roofs of new or expanded factories, parapets or railings at edges shall be at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第227條之1：於邊緣及屋頂突出物頂板周圍設置高度九十公分以上之女兒牆或適當強度欄杆；易踏穿屋頂應設寬度三十公分以上通道並於採光範圍下方裝設堅固格柵。
questions.explain_en: Article 227-1: parapets or adequately strong railings at least 90 cm high at edges and around roof projections; fragile roofs need 30 cm walkways and grilles under skylights.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工於高差超過多少公尺以上之場所作業時，應設置能使勞工安全上下之設備？
questions.q_en: Safe access equipment is required for work at places with a height difference exceeding:
questions.explain_zh: 第228條：雇主對勞工於高差超過一．五公尺以上之場所作業時，應設置能使勞工安全上下之設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 228: safe means of ascent and descent shall be provided where the height difference exceeds 1.5 m.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用之移動梯，其寬度應在多少公分以上？
questions.q_en: A portable ladder shall be at least how wide?
questions.explain_zh: 第229條：移動梯應具堅固構造、材質無顯著損傷腐蝕、寬度應在三十公分以上、應採取防止滑溜或轉動之措施。
questions.explain_en: Article 229: sturdy construction, no significant damage or corrosion, width at least 30 cm, and anti-slip or anti-rotation measures.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 合梯之梯腳與地面之角度應在幾度以內？並禁止勞工於何處作業？
questions.q_en: A stepladder's legs shall form an angle with the ground within how many degrees, and where is standing prohibited?
questions.explain_zh: 第230條：梯腳與地面之角度應在七十五度以內，兩梯腳間有金屬等硬質繫材扣牢，腳部有防滑絕緣腳座套；不得以合梯當作二工作面之上下設備，並禁止勞工站立於頂板作業。
questions.explain_en: Article 230: legs within 75° of the ground, rigid spreaders between legs, non-slip insulated feet; not to be used as access between two work surfaces; standing on the top cap is prohibited.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 自高度在幾公尺以上之場所投下物體有危害勞工之虞時，應設置滑槽、承受設備並指派監視人員？
questions.q_en: When dropping objects from a height of at least how much may endanger workers, chutes, receiving equipment and a watcher are required?
questions.explain_zh: 第237條：自高度在三公尺以上之場所投下物體有危害勞工之虞時，應設置適當之滑槽、承受設備，並指派監視人員。
questions.explain_en: Article 237: from 3 m or higher, provide suitable chutes and receiving equipment and assign a watcher.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使用對地電壓在多少伏特以上之移動式或攜帶式電動機具，應設置防止感電用漏電斷路器？
questions.q_en: Portable or mobile electric tools with a voltage to ground of at least how much require a ground-fault circuit interrupter?
questions.explain_zh: 第243條：使用對地電壓在一百五十伏特以上移動式或攜帶式電動機具；於潮濕場所、金屬板上或鋼架上等導電性良好場所使用移動式或攜帶式電動機具；建築或工程作業使用之臨時用電設備，均應設置高敏感度、高速型漏電斷路器。
questions.explain_en: Article 243: 150 V or more to ground; also portable tools used in wet or conductive places (metal plates, steel frames) and temporary power for construction require high-sensitivity, high-speed GFCIs.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 下列何種電動機具不適用漏電斷路器之規定？
questions.a_zh: 雙重絕緣構造之電動機具
questions.c_zh: 潮濕場所使用之電動工具
questions.q_en: Which electric tool is exempt from the GFCI requirement?
questions.c_en: A power tool used in a wet area
questions.d_en: Temporary power equipment on a construction site
questions.explain_zh: 第244條：連接於非接地方式電路（絕緣變壓器二次側三百伏特以下且負荷側不接地）之電動機具、在絕緣台上使用之電動機具、雙重絕緣構造之電動機具，不適用前條規定。
questions.explain_en: Article 244: tools on ungrounded circuits (isolation transformer secondary ≤300 V, ungrounded load side), tools used on insulated platforms, and double-insulated tools are exempt.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 良導體機器設備內之檢修工作所用之手提式照明燈，其使用電壓不得超過多少伏特？
questions.q_en: Portable lamps used for inspection inside conductive equipment shall not exceed what voltage?
questions.explain_zh: 第249條：手提式照明燈使用電壓不得超過二十四伏特，且導線須為耐磨損及有良好絕緣，並不得有接頭。
questions.explain_en: Article 249: not more than 24 V, with abrasion-resistant, well-insulated cords without joints.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 於良導體機器設備內之狹小空間或鋼架上作業所使用之交流電焊機，應有何種裝置？
questions.q_en: AC arc welders used in confined conductive spaces or on steel frames shall have:
questions.c_en: An automatic electric shock prevention device (voltage reducing device)
questions.explain_zh: 第250條：於良導體機器設備內之狹小空間，或於鋼架等有觸及高導電性接地物之虞之場所，作業時所使用之交流電焊機，應有自動電擊防止裝置。但採自動式焊接者不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 250: AC welders used in narrow spaces of conductive equipment or where contact with grounded conductive objects is likely shall have an automatic shock prevention device, except automatic welding.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 停電作業時，停電作業範圍應以何種顏色之帶或網加圍？有電部分則以何種顏色？
questions.a_zh: 停電作業區紅色、有電危險區藍色
questions.b_zh: 停電作業區藍色、有電危險區紅色
questions.q_en: During de-energized work in a substation, the de-energized area is marked with tape or net of which color, and the live area with which?
questions.a_en: Red for de-energized, blue for live
questions.b_en: Blue for the de-energized area, red for the live area
questions.explain_zh: 第254條第1項第4款：停電作業範圍如為發電或變電設備或開關場之一部分時，應以藍帶或網加圍並懸掛「停電作業區」標誌；有電部分則以紅帶或網加圍並懸掛「有電危險區」標誌。
questions.explain_en: Article 254(1)(4): the de-energized work area is enclosed with blue tape or net and a 'de-energized work area' sign; live parts with red tape or net and a 'live danger area' sign.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 電路開路後從事作業，開路之開關於作業中應如何處理？
questions.b_zh: 上鎖或標示「禁止送電」、「停電作業中」或設置監視人員
questions.q_en: After opening a circuit for work, the opened switch shall be:
questions.b_en: Locked or tagged 'Do not energize' / 'De-energized work in progress', or watched by a person
questions.explain_zh: 第254條第1項第1款：開路之開關於作業中應上鎖或標示「禁止送電」、「停電作業中」或設置監視人員監視之；並應放電、檢電確認停電、短路接地。
questions.explain_en: Article 254(1)(1): lock or tag the opened switch or post a watcher; also discharge residual charge, verify de-energization with a tester, and apply short-circuit grounding.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 接近高壓電路從事作業時，在距離頭上、身側及腳下多少公分以內之高壓電路，應設置絕緣用防護裝備？
questions.q_en: When working near high-voltage circuits, insulating protective equipment must be installed on circuits within how many centimeters above, beside or below the worker?
questions.explain_zh: 第259條：在距離頭上、身側及腳下六十公分以內之高壓電路者，應在該電路設置絕緣用防護裝備。但已使該作業勞工戴用絕緣用防護具而無感電之虞者，不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 259: within 60 cm above the head, beside the body or below the feet, unless the worker wears insulating protective gear with no shock risk.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 特高壓充電電路使用電壓二十二千伏特以下者，勞工身體或金屬工具應保持之接近界限距離為多少公分？
questions.q_en: For extra-high-voltage circuits of 22 kV or less, the minimum approach distance for the worker's body or metal tools is:
questions.explain_zh: 第260條表：二二千伏特以下二○公分；超過二二至三三千伏特三○公分；超過三三至六六千伏特五○公分；超過六六至七七千伏特六○公分；…超過三四五千伏特三○○公分。
questions.explain_en: Article 260 table: ≤22 kV 20 cm; >22–33 kV 30 cm; >33–66 kV 50 cm; >66–77 kV 60 cm; … >345 kV 300 cm.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 低壓（六百伏特以下）供電且契約容量達多少瓩以上之工廠或供公眾使用之建築物，應置初級電氣技術人員？
questions.q_en: Low-voltage factories or public buildings with a contract capacity of at least how many kW must have a junior electrical technician?
questions.explain_zh: 第264條：低壓供電且契約容量達五十瓩以上者應置初級電氣技術人員；高壓供電之用電場所應置中級；特高壓應置高級電氣技術人員。
questions.explain_en: Article 264: low voltage with contract capacity of 50 kW or more: junior technician; high voltage: intermediate; extra-high voltage: senior electrical technician.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 六百伏特以下之電氣設備前方，至少應有多少公分以上之水平工作空間？
questions.q_en: In front of electrical equipment of 600 V or less, the minimum horizontal working space is:
questions.explain_zh: 第268條：六百伏特以下之電氣設備前方至少應有八十公分以上之水平工作空間；低壓帶電體前方可能有活線作業時，依表規定不得低於九十至一百二十公分。
questions.explain_en: Article 268: at least 80 cm; where live-line work on low-voltage parts is possible, the table requires 90–120 cm depending on the environment.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 絕緣用防護裝備、防護具、活線作業用工具等，應每隔多久檢驗其性能一次？
questions.q_en: Insulating protective equipment and live-line tools shall be performance-tested every:
questions.explain_zh: 第272條：絕緣用防護裝備、防護具、活線作業用工具等，應每六個月檢驗其性能一次，工作人員應於每次使用前自行檢點，不合格者應予更換。
questions.explain_en: Article 272: every 6 months, plus a self-check by the worker before each use; failed items must be replaced.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 電氣技術人員以操作棒操作高壓開關時，應使用何種防護具？
questions.q_en: When operating a high-voltage switch with a hot stick, an electrical technician shall wear:
questions.explain_zh: 第274條第4款：以操作棒操作高壓開關，應使用橡皮手套。另拆除或接裝保險絲前應先切斷電源。
questions.explain_en: Article 274(4): rubber gloves shall be used; also cut power before removing or installing fuses.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 為調整電動機械而停電，開關切斷後應如何處理？復電時由何人執行？
questions.a_zh: 貼便條即可；任何人可復電
questions.c_zh: 立即上鎖或掛牌標示並簽章；由原掛簽人取下鎖或掛牌後始可復電
questions.q_en: When power is cut to adjust machinery, what is done after opening the switch, and who may re-energize?
questions.a_en: A sticky note; anyone can re-energize
questions.c_en: Lock or tag and sign immediately; only the person who tagged it removes the lock/tag before re-energizing
questions.explain_zh: 第276條第2款：開關切斷後須立即上鎖或掛牌標示並簽章；復電時應由原掛簽人取下鎖或掛牌後始可復電。原掛簽人因故無法執行時，雇主應指派職務代理人處理。
questions.explain_en: Article 276(2): lock/tag and sign immediately; re-energize only after the original tagger removes the lock or tag; a designated deputy handles it if the tagger is unavailable.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 遇電氣設備或電路著火時，應使用何種滅火設備？
questions.q_en: For fires in electrical equipment or circuits, use:
questions.explain_zh: 第276條第10款：遇電氣設備或電路著火者，應用不導電之滅火設備。另不得以肩負方式攜帶竹梯、鐵管等過長物體接近電氣設備；不得以濕手操作開關。
questions.explain_en: Article 276(10): use non-conductive extinguishing equipment; also do not carry long objects like bamboo ladders or pipes on the shoulder near electrical equipment, and never operate switches with wet hands.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主供給勞工使用之個人防護具，其數量應如何準備？
questions.b_zh: 與作業勞工人數相同或以上，並以個人專用為原則
questions.q_en: How many personal protective items must the employer provide?
questions.b_en: At least as many as the number of workers, for individual use in principle
questions.explain_zh: 第277條第3款：個人使用之防護具應置備與作業勞工人數相同或以上之數量，並以個人專用為原則；對有感染疾病之虞時應置備個人專用防護器具。
questions.explain_en: Article 277(3): a quantity equal to or greater than the number of workers, for individual use in principle; individual equipment is required where infection risk exists.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數達多少人以上，雇主應訂定呼吸防護計畫並據以執行？
questions.q_en: Employers with at least how many workers must formulate a written respiratory protection program?
questions.explain_zh: 第277條之1：使勞工使用呼吸防護具時應指派專人採取危害辨識、防護具選擇、使用、維護管理、教育訓練、成效評估等措施，紀錄留存三年；勞工人數達二百人以上者應訂定呼吸防護計畫。
questions.explain_en: Article 277-1: respiratory protection measures (hazard identification, selection, use, maintenance, training, evaluation) with 3-year records; a written program is required at 200 or more workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 對於二公尺以上未設護籠之垂直固定梯、局限空間、屋頂或施工架組拆等高處作業，應採用何種安全帶？
questions.a_zh: 全身背負式安全帶及捲揚式防墜器
questions.q_en: For vertical fixed ladders over 2 m without cages, confined spaces, roofs or scaffold assembly, what harness is required?
questions.a_en: A full-body harness (CNS 14253-1) with a self-retracting lifeline
questions.explain_zh: 第281條第2項：對於鋼構懸臂突出物、斜籬、二公尺以上未設護籠之垂直固定梯、局限空間、屋頂或施工架組拆、工作台組拆、管線維修等高處或傾斜面移動，應採用符合CNS 14253-1之全身背負式安全帶及捲揚式防墜器。
questions.explain_en: Article 281(2): for steel cantilevers, catch fans, uncaged vertical ladders over 2 m, confined spaces, roof or scaffold assembly/dismantling, platform assembly and pipeline maintenance, a full-body harness meeting CNS 14253-1 with a self-retracting fall arrester is required.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 事業單位從事外送作業勞工人數在多少人以上，雇主應訂定外送作業危害防止計畫？
questions.q_en: Employers with at least how many delivery workers must formulate a delivery-work hazard prevention plan?
questions.explain_zh: 第286條之3：使用機車、自行車從事外送作業，應置備安全帽、反光標示、高低氣溫危害預防、緊急連絡通訊設備等；外送作業勞工人數在三十人以上者應訂定外送作業危害防止計畫，紀錄留存三年。
questions.explain_en: Article 286-3: helmets, reflective markings, heat/cold protection and emergency communication for motorcycle/bicycle delivery; a hazard prevention plan is required at 30 or more delivery workers, records kept 3 years.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使勞工使用輸氣管面罩呼吸防護具時，應避免使用何種氣體供氣？
questions.q_en: When supplying air-line respirators, the employer shall avoid supplying:
questions.explain_zh: 第287條之1：應確保其供氣及性能維持正常運作，並避免使用純氧供氣；使用空氣壓縮機供氣者，輸氣管線及接頭應明顯標示種類及用途，相鄰管線接頭應以不同規格區隔。
questions.explain_en: Article 287-1: ensure proper supply and performance and avoid pure oxygen; with compressors, label air lines and use different fitting sizes for adjacent lines.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 坑內、深井、沉箱、儲槽等自然換氣不充分之工作場所，原則上不得使用何種機械？
questions.q_en: In pits, deep wells, caissons, tanks and other poorly ventilated places, which machines must not be used in principle?
questions.explain_zh: 第295條：於坑內、深井、沉箱、儲槽、隧道、船艙等場所應依缺氧症預防規則採取措施；不得使用具有內燃機之機械，以免排出之廢氣危害勞工。但另設有效之換氣設施者不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 295: internal combustion engines must not be used in such places because of exhaust gases, unless effective ventilation is provided; the Hypoxia Prevention Rules also apply.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 氧氣濃度未達百分之多少之場所，應設置警告標示牌並禁止非作業人員進入？
questions.q_en: Places with oxygen concentration below what percentage require warning signs and exclusion of non-workers?
questions.explain_zh: 第299條第4款：氧氣濃度未達百分之十八之場所。其他包括處置大量高熱或低溫物體、強烈非游離輻射、有害物超過容許暴露標準、遭受生物病原體顯著污染之場所。
questions.explain_en: Article 299(4): below 18% oxygen; also places handling large amounts of hot or cold objects, strong non-ionizing radiation, hazardous substances above exposure limits, or significant biological contamination.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工八小時日時量平均音壓級超過多少分貝或暴露劑量超過百分之多少時，雇主應使勞工戴用防音防護具？
questions.a_zh: 八十五分貝或百分之五十
questions.c_zh: 八十分貝或百分之三十
questions.d_zh: 九十五分貝或百分之百
questions.q_en: Hearing protectors are mandatory when the 8-hour TWA sound level exceeds what, or the dose exceeds what?
questions.explain_zh: 第300條第1款：八小時日時量平均音壓級超過八十五分貝或暴露劑量超過百分之五十時，應使勞工戴用有效之耳塞、耳罩等防音防護具；機械噪音超過九十分貝時應採工程控制；任何時間不得暴露於峰值超過一百四十分貝之衝擊性噪音或一百十五分貝之連續性噪音。
questions.explain_en: Article 300(1): 85 dBA TWA or 50% dose requires hearing protectors; over 90 dB requires engineering controls; never exceed 140 dB impulse peak or 115 dB continuous.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 依噪音容許暴露時間對照表，A權噪音音壓級九十五分貝之工作日容許暴露時間為多久？
questions.q_en: Per the permissible noise exposure table, the daily limit at 95 dBA is:
questions.explain_zh: 第300條表：九十分貝八小時、九十二分貝六小時、九十五分貝四小時、九十七分貝三小時、一百分貝二小時、一百零五分貝一小時、一百一十分貝半小時、一百一十五分貝四分之一小時。
questions.explain_en: Article 300 table: 90 dBA 8 h; 92 dBA 6 h; 95 dBA 4 h; 97 dBA 3 h; 100 dBA 2 h; 105 dBA 1 h; 110 dBA 0.5 h; 115 dBA 0.25 h.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 事業單位勞工人數達多少人以上，對於噪音超過八十五分貝之工作場所應訂定聽力保護計畫？
questions.q_en: Employers with at least how many workers must formulate a hearing conservation program for workplaces over 85 dBA?
questions.explain_zh: 第300條之1：八小時日時量平均音壓級超過八十五分貝或劑量超過百分之五十之工作場所，應採取噪音監測、危害控制、防音防護具、教育訓練、健康檢查、成效評估等聽力保護措施，紀錄留存三年；勞工人數達一百人以上者應訂定聽力保護計畫。
questions.explain_en: Article 300-1: hearing conservation measures (monitoring, controls, protectors, training, health exams, evaluation) with 3-year records; a written program at 100 or more workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 局部振動作業每日容許暴露時間四小時以上未滿八小時者，其最大加速度值不得超過每平方秒幾公尺？
questions.q_en: For hand-arm vibration with daily exposure of 4 to under 8 hours, the maximum acceleration is:
questions.explain_zh: 第302條表：四小時以上未滿八小時 4 m/s²；二小時以上未滿四小時 6 m/s²；一小時以上未滿二小時 8 m/s²；未滿一小時 12 m/s²。並應使勞工使用防振把手等設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 302 table: 4–<8 h: 4 m/s²; 2–<4 h: 6 m/s²; 1–<2 h: 8 m/s²; <1 h: 12 m/s²; anti-vibration handles are also required.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 戶外作業熱危害風險等級達熱指數對照表第幾級以上者，應設置遮陽設施及具降溫效果之休息場所？
questions.q_en: For outdoor work, shading and cooled rest areas are required when the heat-hazard risk level reaches at least which level of the heat index table?
questions.explain_zh: 第303條之1：熱危害風險等級達表三熱指數對照表第四級以上者，應設置遮陽設施並提供風扇、水霧等降溫設備，並於鄰近設置具冷氣、風扇或自然通風之休息場所及充足飲水。
questions.explain_en: Article 303-1: at level 4 or above, provide shade, fans or water mist, a nearby rest area with air conditioning, fans or good ventilation, and adequate drinking water.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 坑內之溫度應保持在攝氏幾度以下？超過時應使勞工停止作業？
questions.q_en: Underground (pit) temperature shall be kept below what, above which work must stop?
questions.explain_zh: 第308條：坑內之溫度應保持在攝氏三十七度以下；溫度在三十七度以上時應使勞工停止作業。但已採取防止高溫危害措施、從事救護或搶救作業者不在此限。
questions.explain_en: Article 308: below 37°C; at 37°C or above workers must stop, except with heat-hazard controls or during rescue work.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 勞工經常作業之室內作業場所，每一勞工原則上應有多少立方公尺以上之空間（設備及高度超過四公尺之空間不計）？
questions.q_en: In indoor workplaces where workers regularly work, each worker shall in principle have at least how much space (excluding equipment and space above 4 m)?
questions.explain_zh: 第309條：除設備及自地面算起高度超過四公尺以上之空間不計外，每一勞工原則上應有十立方公尺以上之空間。
questions.explain_en: Article 309: at least 10 m³ per worker, excluding equipment and space higher than 4 m above the floor.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 室內作業場所可直接與大氣相通之開口部分面積，應為地板面積之幾分之一以上？
questions.q_en: Openings of an indoor workplace communicating directly with outside air shall be at least what fraction of the floor area?
questions.explain_zh: 第311條：窗戶及其他開口部分面積應為地板面積之二十分之一以上（設有充分換氣能力之機械通風設備者除外）；氣溫在十度以下換氣時不得使勞工暴露於每秒一公尺以上之氣流中。
questions.explain_en: Article 311: at least 1/20 of the floor area, unless mechanical ventilation of sufficient capacity is installed; when ventilating at 10°C or below, air speed on workers must not exceed 1 m/s.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 依設施規則第313條照度表，一般辦公場所之人工照明應達多少米燭光以上？
questions.q_en: Per the illumination table of Article 313, general offices require artificial lighting of at least:
questions.explain_zh: 第313條表：室外走道二十米燭光；走道樓梯倉庫五十；機械鍋爐房更衣室廁所一百；須細辨物體二百；須精辨物體及一般辦公場所三百；須極細辨五百至一千；極精辨對襯不良一千以上。窗面面積比率不得小於室內地面十分之一。
questions.explain_en: Article 313 table: outdoor walkways 20 lux; corridors/stairs/warehouses 50; machine rooms, changing rooms, toilets 100; fine work 200; precise work and general offices 300; very fine work 500–1,000; extremely fine work 1,000+. Window area at least 1/10 of floor area.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 刺激物、腐蝕性物質或毒性物質污染之工作場所，每幾人應設置一個冷熱水沖淋設備？每幾人設置一個冷熱水盥洗設備？
questions.a_zh: 每十五人沖淋；每五人盥洗
questions.b_zh: 每五人沖淋；每二人盥洗
questions.c_zh: 每十人沖淋；每三人盥洗
questions.d_zh: 每二十人沖淋；每十人盥洗
questions.q_en: In workplaces contaminated by irritants, corrosives or toxic substances, one hot/cold shower is required per how many workers, and one washing facility per how many?
questions.explain_zh: 第318條：刺激物、腐蝕性物質或毒性物質污染之工作場所，每十五人應設置一個冷熱水沖淋設備，每五人應設置一個冷熱水盥洗設備。
questions.explain_en: Article 318: one hot-and-cold shower per 15 workers and one hot-and-cold washing facility per 5 workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 男用廁所之大便器數目，以同時作業男工每幾人以內設置一個以上為原則？廁所與廚房及食堂應距離多少公尺以上？
questions.q_en: Men's toilets: at least one water closet per how many male workers, and toilets at least how far from kitchens and dining rooms?
questions.explain_zh: 第319條：男用大便器每二十五人以內一個（最少不低於六十人一個）；男用小便器每十五人一個；女用大便器每十五人一個；廁所與廚房及食堂應距離三十公尺以上（衛生沖水式除外）；每日清洗一次、每週消毒一次。
questions.explain_en: Article 319: one WC per 25 men (minimum one per 60); one urinal per 15 men; one WC per 15 women; toilets at least 30 m from kitchens and dining rooms (except flush toilets); cleaned daily and disinfected weekly.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 雇主供應勞工飲用水時，下列何者正確？
questions.a_zh: 可設置共用杯具以節省成本
questions.q_en: When providing drinking water, which is correct?
questions.a_en: Shared cups are fine to save cost
questions.b_en: No shared cups may be provided
questions.d_en: Industrial water can be used for drinking
questions.explain_zh: 第320條：飲水處所及容器應保持清潔並加蓋；不得設置共用之杯具；飲用水應符合飲用水水質衛生標準，非自來水水源應定期檢驗合格；非飲用水之水源應有明顯標誌。
questions.explain_en: Article 320: keep dispensers clean and covered; no shared cups; water must meet drinking-water standards and non-tap sources must be tested regularly; label non-potable sources.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 餐廳面積應以同時進餐之人數每人多少平方公尺以上為原則？通風窗面積不得少於總面積百分之多少？
questions.a_zh: 一．五平方公尺；百分之五
questions.b_zh: 二平方公尺；百分之二十
questions.d_zh: 一平方公尺；百分之十二
questions.q_en: A dining room should provide at least how much area per person eating at the same time, and ventilation windows of at least what percentage of total area?
questions.explain_zh: 第322條：餐廳面積以同時進餐人數每人一平方公尺以上為原則；通風窗之面積不得少於總面積百分之十二；應採三槽式洗滌暨餐具消毒設備、廚房設機械排氣裝置。
questions.explain_en: Article 322: at least 1 m² per person; ventilation windows at least 12% of total area; three-compartment sinks with disinfection, and mechanical exhaust in kitchens.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使勞工從事重複性作業，為預防肌肉骨骼疾病，勞工人數達多少人以上之事業單位應訂定人因性危害預防計畫？
questions.q_en: To prevent musculoskeletal disorders from repetitive work, enterprises with at least how many workers must formulate an ergonomic hazard prevention plan?
questions.explain_zh: 第324條之1：應分析作業流程、確認人因性危害因子、評估選定改善方法、評估成效，紀錄留存三年；勞工人數達一百人以上者應訂定人因性危害預防計畫。
questions.explain_en: Article 324-1: analyze work processes, identify ergonomic risk factors, select and implement improvements, evaluate results, keep records 3 years; a written plan at 100 or more workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 為預防輪班、夜間工作、長時間工作等異常工作負荷促發疾病，何種事業單位應訂定預防計畫？
questions.c_zh: 依規定配置有醫護人員從事勞工健康服務者
questions.q_en: Which enterprises must formulate a written plan to prevent diseases induced by abnormal workloads (shift, night, long hours)?
questions.c_en: Those required to have medical personnel providing labor health services
questions.explain_zh: 第324條之2：應辨識評估高風險群、安排醫師面談及健康指導、調整工時、健康檢查管理等，紀錄留存三年；依規定配置有醫護人員從事勞工健康服務者，應訂定異常工作負荷促發疾病預防計畫；免配置者得以執行紀錄代替。
questions.explain_en: Article 324-2: identify high-risk groups, arrange physician interviews and guidance, adjust hours, manage health exams, keep records 3 years; a written plan is required where medical personnel are mandated, otherwise records suffice.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 為預防勞工執行職務遭受不法侵害，勞工人數達多少人以上之事業單位應訂定執行職務遭受不法侵害預防計畫？
questions.q_en: Enterprises with at least how many workers must formulate a written plan to prevent unlawful harm (workplace violence) while performing duties?
questions.explain_zh: 第324條之3：應辨識評估危害、適當配置作業場所、建構行為規範、辦理訓練、設置申訴管道並公開揭示、建立調查處理程序、提供法律醫療心理協助等，紀錄留存三年；勞工人數達一百人以上者應訂定預防計畫。
questions.explain_en: Article 324-3: hazard identification, workplace layout, code of conduct, training, complaint channels, investigation procedures, legal/medical/psychological assistance, 3-year records; a written plan at 100 or more workers.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 對於連續站立作業之勞工，雇主應設置何種設備供休息時使用？
questions.q_en: For workers who stand continuously, the employer shall provide:
questions.b_en: Suitable seats for use during breaks
questions.explain_zh: 第324條之5：雇主對於連續站立作業之勞工，應設置適當之坐具，以供休息時使用。
questions.explain_en: Article 324-5: suitable seating shall be provided for rest breaks for workers who stand continuously.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 使勞工從事戶外作業防範熱疾病之危害預防措施，不包括下列何者？
questions.a_zh: 提供適當之飲料或食鹽水
questions.b_zh: 禁止勞工飲水以免上廁所
questions.c_zh: 實施勞工熱適應相關措施
questions.q_en: Which is NOT a heat-illness prevention measure for outdoor work under Article 324-6?
questions.a_en: Providing suitable drinks or salt water
questions.b_en: Forbidding water to avoid toilet breaks
questions.explain_zh: 第324條之6：降低作業場所溫度、提供陰涼休息場所、提供飲料或食鹽水、調整作業時間、增加巡視頻率、健康管理及適當安排工作、熱適應措施、留意健康狀況、教育宣導、建立緊急醫療通報應變機制。
questions.explain_en: Article 324-6 lists lowering temperature, shaded rest areas, drinks or salt water, adjusted hours, more frequent patrols, health management, acclimatization, monitoring workers' condition, education, and emergency medical/reporting mechanisms.

questions.law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
questions.q_zh: 自營作業者獨立作業或以其作業交付承攬時，是否適用設施規則有關雇主義務之規定？
questions.q_en: Do the employer obligations in the Rules apply to self-employed persons working independently or contracting out their work?
questions.explain_zh: 第326條之1：自營作業者獨立作業或以其作業交付承攬時，適用本規則有關雇主義務之規定；受工作場所負責人指揮或監督從事勞動之人員，比照該事業單位之勞工適用本規則。
questions.explain_en: Article 326-1: yes; and persons working under the direction of a workplace manager are treated like that enterprise's laborers under the Rules.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 營造安全衛生設施標準所稱「露天開挖」，下列敘述何者正確？
questions.a_zh: 僅指深度超過五公尺之開挖
questions.c_zh: 於室外採人工或機械實施土、砂、岩石等之開挖，包括基礎開挖、管溝開挖與整地
questions.q_en: Under the Construction Safety and Health Facilities Standards, 'open excavation' means:
questions.c_en: Outdoor manual or mechanical excavation of soil, sand or rock, including foundation, trench and grading work
questions.explain_zh: 第1條之1：露天開挖指於室外採人工或機械實施土、砂、岩石等之開挖，包括土木構造物、建築物之基礎開挖、地下埋設物之管溝開挖與整地及其他相關之開挖。
questions.explain_en: Article 1-1: open excavation is outdoor manual or mechanical excavation of soil, sand, rock, etc., including foundations for structures and buildings, trenches for underground utilities, grading and related excavation.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 依營造標準第3條，雇主應於何階段依設計階段之風險評估及圖說實施風險評估，並將安全衛生設施納入考量？
questions.q_en: Under Article 3, at which stage shall the employer conduct a risk assessment based on the design-stage assessment and drawings?
questions.explain_zh: 第3條第1款：於施工規劃階段，應依設計階段之風險評估及圖說等資料，實施風險評估，並將必要之安全衛生設施納入考量；依規定須有施工計畫者應納入施工計畫。工程施工期間包含開工前準備及竣工後驗收、保固維修期間。
questions.explain_en: Article 3(1): at the construction planning stage, based on design-stage risk assessment and drawings, incorporating necessary safety facilities into the construction plan; the construction period includes pre-work preparation and post-completion acceptance and warranty maintenance.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 工作場所暴露之鋼筋、鋼材等易生職業災害者，應採取何種防護設施？
questions.d_zh: 彎曲尖端、加蓋或加裝護套
questions.q_en: Exposed rebar, steel and similar materials in the workplace shall be protected by:
questions.d_en: Bending the tips, capping or sleeving them
questions.explain_zh: 第5條：對於工作場所暴露之鋼筋、鋼材、鐵件、鋁件及其他材料等易生職業災害者，應採取彎曲尖端、加蓋或加裝護套等防護設施。
questions.explain_en: Article 5: exposed rebar, steel, iron, aluminum and other materials shall have their tips bent, capped or fitted with protective sleeves.

questions.law: 營造安全衛生設施標準
questions.q_zh: 工作場所之周圍原則上應設置何種圍籬？大規模土木工程得以何者替代？
questions.a_zh: 移動式圍籬；固定式圍籬
questions.d_zh: 固定式圍籬；移動式圍籬或警示帶圍成之警示區
questions.q_en: What fencing is required around a construction site, and what may large civil works use instead?
